name: wide-negative-key-fails-8-bits-and-matches-64
reference: spec 0.52 Choosing the kind: the implicit term fails only when the entity holds the key with a value the `when` does not match; ruling 7 of 0.30: a value is matched as an unsigned 64-bit pattern, and a negative one never matches fewer than 64 bits; -1: short fails, long is 2^64-1
